title: OP Auto Farm 40k an hour
features:
S.W.A.T. Money Autofarm Script

This script automatically farms money by repeatedly completing the ball objective in the S.W.A.T. game mode. It handles the entire process from start to finish for maximum cash efficiency.

Features:
- Auto Team Assignment – Automatically touches Swatspawn until you're placed on the S.W.A.T. team
- Intelligent Ball Detection – Waits for the ball to become available (Transparency 0 and no owner)
- Auto Collection – Automatically touches the ball to pick it up
- Auto Delivery – Automatically touches VaultSWAT to score and earn money
- Round Reset – Detects when the ball is deleted (round ends), waits 60 seconds, then respawns you to continue farming
- Error Handling – Prevents "primitives overlap" errors by validating all parts before interactions
- Continuous Loop – Runs indefinitely until manually stopped

How to Use:
1. Load the script into your executor
2. Execute while in the game
3. Let it run – the script handles everything automatically
4. Earn money passively while AFK

Requirements:
- Your executor MUST have `firetouchinterest`, otherwise the script will not work.

Note: The script runs on a continuous loop, automatically restarting after each successful delivery or round end. Perfect for AFK money farming.
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local swatspawn = workspace:FindFirstChild("Swatspawn")

if swatspawn then
    repeat
        local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        firetouchinterest(hrp, swatspawn, 0)
        firetouchinterest(hrp, swatspawn, 1)
        task.wait(2)
    until player.Team and player.Team.Name == "S.W.A.T."
end

task.wait(1)

while true do
    local model = workspace:FindFirstChild("Model")
    if model then
        local ball = model:FindFirstChild("Ball")
        
        if ball then
            local ballBall = ball:FindFirstChild("Ball")
            
            if ballBall then
                local owner = ballBall:FindFirstChild("Owner")
                
                if ballBall.Transparency == 0 and (not owner or owner.Value == nil) then
                    local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    
                    if hrp and ballBall then
                        firetouchinterest(hrp, ballBall, 0)
                        task.wait(0.1)
                        firetouchinterest(hrp, ballBall, 1)
                        task.wait(0.5)
                        
                        local vault = ball:FindFirstChild("VaultSWAT")
                        if vault and hrp then
                            firetouchinterest(hrp, vault, 0)
                            task.wait(0.1)
                            firetouchinterest(hrp, vault, 1)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            print("Ball deleted, game over. Waiting 60 seconds...")
            task.wait(60)
            
            local swatspawn = workspace:FindFirstChild("Swatspawn")
            if swatspawn then
                local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then
                    firetouchinterest(hrp, swatspawn, 0)
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    firetouchinterest(hrp, swatspawn, 1)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    task.wait(0.5)
end
